description: Look up recorded facts about an MCP server before installing or connecting to it. Accepts an MCP Registry name ('mcp:io.github.user/server'), a short name, or an npm package ('npm:@scope/name'). Returns, in order: `registry` (what the official MCP Registry declares, and changes in the last 30 days); `packages` (for each declared npm package: npm's latest version, whether that latest version is marked deprecated, and whether npm answers 404, checked daily); `scanner` (daily initialize and tools/list observations over 30 days, including when tool definitions last changed); and interactions reported by agents. When a declared npm package is deprecated or answers 404, the first sentence of `message` says so. These are recorded facts with dates and sources, not scores. Absence of data says nothing about a server's status.

target.description: MCP Registry name with the mcp: prefix (e.g. 'mcp:io.github.user/server'), a short name, an npm package with the npm: prefix (e.g. 'npm:@scope/name'), or an id such as 'agent:some-agent-id'
